live_limit: Local payment plus separate real Sepolia approval. No KeeperHub payment yet.

scenes.caption: Payroom keeps an invoice, its approval and its receipt together. This is a local test.
Create a test invoice for 12.50 pUSD. A saved draft does not approve a payment.
Review the work, full recipient address and exact amount before approving.
The Safe records these exact terms on chain. The keeper cannot replace them.
Pause stops the keeper, including for invoices that are already approved.
The owner can resume payments. The invoice keeps its approved terms.
The local keeper now pays 12.50 pUSD from the Safe, within its daily limit.
This receipt is from the local chain. A paid invoice cannot be paid a second time.
The activity log keeps each approval, control change and payment attempt.
Export the invoice and its chain receipts together as a JSON record.
This is a separate Sepolia example, with a real Safe approval on the public testnet.
The approval receipt can be checked on Etherscan. This invoice is still unpaid.
KeeperHub execution is still pending. Its actual payment and receipt will be in the final demo.
